get.summary:
Read the authenticated owner's current policy. The account is rechecked in
SQL; admin roles do not select another owner. An absent policy is seeded as shadow.

200.description: Current owner policy and positive CAS revision

401.description: AUTH_INVALID_CREDENTIALS: missing/invalid JWT, inactive account

503.description: SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: read/storage unavailable; this is not a mutation receipt

put.summary:
Replace all policy fields using compare-and-swap. Unknown fields are rejected.
Enabled requires an installed live runner; it does not prove a device is ready.
On 503, GET and compare the original intent before retrying that exact revision
and policy. Never silently advance expected_revision to overwrite another change.

200.description: Committed replacement with incremented revision

400.description: VALIDATION_ERROR: malformed/unknown fields, invalid bounds, or live runner unavailable for enabled mode

401.description: AUTH_INVALID_CREDENTIALS: missing/invalid JWT, inactive account

409.description: VERSION_CONFLICT: original revision is no longer current; read current policy and decide explicitly

503.description: COMPANION_POLICY_UNCONFIRMED: completion unknown, with original expected_revision; read current policy before retrying the same intent

get.summary:
Read and deterministically replay this owner's original frozen report after
rechecking current source/owner authority. This never retries audio or grants live output.

200.description: Original frozen inputs and pure decision after current authority recheck

400.description: Nil UUID: JSON VALIDATION_ERROR; malformed UUID: Axum plain-text path rejection

401.description: AUTH_INVALID_CREDENTIALS: missing/invalid JWT, inactive account

403.description: AUTH_FORBIDDEN: missing/other-owner operation or current private-read authority unavailable; no existence disclosure

410.description: COMPANION_EVIDENCE_ERASED with operation_id: private evidence erased, expired or revoked; replay is unavailable

503.description: SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: read/storage unavailable; retry this same read

post.summary:
Evaluate existing canonical Appraisals without generating output or consuming
live admission budget. Request fields cannot supply owner, opportunity or authority.
Repeating the same operation and Appraisal set reads its original frozen receipt;
changing that intent conflicts. A new shadow operation while enabled is unavailable.

200.description: Bounded frozen report; up to 32 examined sources and 4 decisions, never output authority

400.description: VALIDATION_ERROR: malformed/unknown fields, nil IDs, duplicate IDs or batch outside 1–32

401.description: AUTH_INVALID_CREDENTIALS: missing/invalid JWT, inactive account

403.description: AUTH_FORBIDDEN: canonical sources or current private-read authority unavailable

409.description: VERSION_CONFLICT: operation identity/worklist or canonical policy authority changed

410.description: COMPANION_EVIDENCE_ERASED with operation_id: original evidence erased, expired or revoked; it cannot be reconstructed by retry

503.description: COMPANION_SHADOW_UNCONFIRMED with operation_id: completion unknown; retry exactly the same operation_id and appraisal_ids

awaiting_response.description: Canonical response tracking only; absence never means user dislike.

CanonicalObservation.description:
A bounded canonical source header. No message text, inferred emotion,
free-form topic, or private reason is copied into the decision record.

effective_at.description: Original canonical Appraisal time, never the worker's scan time.

CompanionErrorResponse.description: Companion mutation and erasure receipts require their original operation identity.

daily_budget.description: Admissions per UTC date, including outcomes that remain unknown.

intent_digest.description: Exact digest returned by the effect to which the owner is consenting.

DecisionReason.description: Declaration order is the versioned, stable ordering in a decision record.

catalog_digest.description: Snapshot of the database-owned catalog policy, checked under row lock.

source_privacy_epoch.description: Source admission epoch; never refreshed when queued work executes.

source_received_at.description: First trusted source observation; retransmission never replaces it.

arguments.description: JSON object, at most 16 KiB when encoded. Tool schema is validated by the adapter.

call_id.description: Optional model correlation label; changing this does not create a new effect.

request_id.description: Non-nil UUID generated by the caller; retain it for retries of this operation.

latest_checkpoint.description: A later device fact does not rewrite the frozen Unknown outcome.

expected_revision.description: Positive revision returned by GET; retries retain this original revision and policy.

policy.description: Full replacement; all seven policy fields are required.

last_seen_at.description: Last time a reading was received

registered_at.description: When the sensor was first registered

sensor_id.description: Unique sensor identifier, for example "room:temperature" or "plugin.weather:humidity".

latest_only.description: If true, return only the latest reading per sensor

SensorReading.description: A single sensor reading (time-series data point).

appraisal_ids.description: 1–32 distinct nonzero canonical Appraisal IDs belonging to this owner.

operation_id.description: Nonzero caller-generated identity. Retain it with the same Appraisal set on retry.

preferred_tools.description: Tool names preferred during this skill's execution.
